title: Business Relationship Manager Associate Director - Nordic Business Unit
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

*This role is also open to candidates based in Denmark or Sweden.*
 We are seeking an experienced Business Relationship Manager (BRM) at Associate Director level to serve as the primary interface between the EY global’ s Enterprise Technology (ET) organization and Nordic Business Unit within the Europe Central region.
   

  

 As the senior Enterprise Technology representative for the Nordics, you will operate as the trusted technology business partner to Nordic executive leadership—balancing local regulatory, financial, and operational realities with global technology standards, roadmaps, and investment decisions.
   

  

 In practice, you will act as the de facto local IT leadership voice for the Nordic countries, owning executive engagement, risk escalation, financial transparency, and business impact across all enterprise technology services.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 An opportunity exists for a Business Relationship Manager (BRM) to represent Enterprise Technology (ET) across the Nordic Business Unit, covering Denmark, Finland, Norway and Sweden.
   

  

 The BRM will work closely with Nordic executive leadership, enablement functions, vendors and regional CTO team and global ET teams to:
   

  

* Act as the primary technology point of contact for the Nordic business unit and, in some cases, as the de‑facto local IT leadership representative
* Understand business demand, priorities and performance expectations, and translate these into effective adoption of enterprise technology solutions
* Represent Nordic business‑unit requirements, risks and regulatory considerations into ET roadmaps, decisions and governance forums
* Support transparency and confidence in technology financial planning, investment decisions and ongoing cost management
* Ensure that enterprise technology services are delivered and operated in line with Nordic local business, legal and regulatory obligations


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Business Partnership & Relationship Management
* Act as the primary Enterprise Technology point of contact for the Nordic business unit, building trusted relationships with senior business, enablement and regional CTO stakeholders.
* Understand business demand, priorities and performance expectations, and translate these into appropriate enterprise and workplace‑related technology solutions, in collaboration with enablement functions.
* Guide stakeholders in navigating the ET organization, ensuring clarity on ownership, prioritization and decision‑making.
* Enterprise Technology Governance & Roadmaps
* Build strong relationships with ET Product Line Leaders and global ET functions, understanding solution capabilities and roadmaps.
* Advocate for Nordic business‑unit needs, constraints and priorities in global forums, balancing local requirements with global standards and governance.
* Identify and sponsor opportunities to improve end‑user experience across enterprise and workplace technologies, and manage expectations during roll‑outs, upgrades and adoption.
* Financial Governance & Transparency
* Contribute to enterprise technology budget planning and tracking for the Nordic business unit.
* Provide transparency on cost and value implications of ET solutions, supporting informed prioritization and investment decisions.
* Facilitate reporting to Nordic leadership on progress and financial impact of business‑unit‑funded initiatives.
* Risk, Compliance & Vendor Interface
* Act as a key Nordic point of contact for IT, data security and vendor‑related compliance matters, in collaboration with legal, quality and compliance teams.
* Support preparedness, reviews and reporting related to local regulatory and compliance obligations, working with Global ET teams, risk management, legal, procurement and vendors as required.
* Incidents, Escalations & Service Impact
* Serve as the Nordic point of contact for enterprise technology incidents, outages and business escalations.
* Coordinate with global ET teams to ensure timely resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and assessment of Nordic business impact related to deployments or service changes.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Ability to be based in and permitted to work in Norway; exceptions may be considered for other Nordic locations
* Fluency in a Scandinavian language is required, with a preference for Norwegian
* Passionate about enhancing employee experience through technology
* Ability to creatively apply IT to solve business problems, with a focus on customer needs and expectations
* Ability to operate successfully in a global multi-cultural and partnership organizational environment
* Ability to communicate financial and technical information to a diverse business audience
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities


*Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.*
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Relationship building & stakeholder management – Ability to establish trusted relationships with senior business leaders, enablement functions, vendors and global technology teams, and operate as a credible business advisor.
* Business and technology acumen – Strong understanding of enterprise technology services, governance and operating models, with the ability to translate business needs into technology outcomes.
* Financial and commercial awareness – Ability to understand, explain and challenge technology costs, investments and trade‑offs to support sound decision‑making.
* Structured problem solving – Ability to assess complex, ambiguous situations, identify implications for the business unit, and drive resolution across a matrixed organisation.
* Governance, risk and compliance mindset – Comfort engaging on data security, regulatory and vendor‑related matters, in partnership with risk, legal and compliance functions.
* Communication & influence – Ability to communicate clearly at executive level, tailor messages to diverse audiences and influence outcomes without formal authority.
* Cultural & matrix agility – Ability to work effectively across countries, cultures and global teams, balancing local needs with global standards and expectations.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A Technology or Business-related degree, or equivalent work experience
* 10+ years of proven experience in a leadership position, with a minimum of 5 years in Technology infrastructure management requiring customer interaction.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL and project management


**What We Look For**
 Experienced senior level leader in Technology Infrastructure management with a wide array of exposure to end user technology, networking and data processing operations. The candidate must have an outgoing interpersonal style with excellent communication skills at executive level. He/She should see approaching problems long before other people in the team sees it and offer/advocate for solutions to these problems. The candidate must be able to deal with a high degree of complexity and ambiguity.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

  

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

  

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**EY | Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Data Scientist - Vikariat
description:
*Vill du arbeta i teknikens framkant med avancerade AI-lösningar som gör konkret skillnad för kunder och verksamhet? Som Data Scientist på Agria får du en nyckelroll i att vidareutveckla och bygga nya AI-tjänster inom NLP och Computer Vision med målet att automatisera och effektivisera skaderegleringsprocessen. Rollen är ett vikariat på 12 månader, med goda möjligheter till förlängning, i ett litet innovativt team där du får stort inflytande och nära samarbete med både IT och affärssidan.*
**Om jobbet**
 I denna roll får du chansen att arbeta i teknikens framkant med avancerade AI-lösningar. Dina huvudsakliga fokusområden blir NLP och Computer Vision med automation och effektivisering som slutmål. Vi använder primärt Python och moderna verktyg inom Azure, där du kommer bidra till lösningar i produktion för våra nordiska marknader samt övriga Europa. Du kommer att ha möjlighet att påverka, driva tillväxt och skapa positiva effekter för både kunder och verksamheten genom smart teknik.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat:
   

  

* Vidareutveckla befintliga AI-lösningar i produktion samt implementera och produktionssätta nya AI-lösningar som effektiviserar och automatiserar Agrias skaderegleringsprocess.
* Utveckla lösningar inom bildanalys, språkteknologi (NLP/LLM) och andra AI-tekniker.
* Kontinuerligt utforska, utvärdera och tillämpa nya AI-tekniker och arbetssätt.
* Utveckla cloud-baserade lösningar med microservices- och event-driven arkitektur.
* Utveckla och arbeta i vårt data-warehouse med avancerad analys av konkreta affärsproblem.
* Samarbeta nära utvecklingsteam, affärsutvecklare, produktägare och andra specialister på Agria samt Länsförsäkringar.
* Delta i tvärfunktionella projekt där IT och affärsverksamheten samverkar för att leverera högkvalitativa och innovativa lösningar.


 Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:
   

  

* Master- eller doktorsexamen inom datavetenskap, matematik, statistik, fysik eller liknande område.
* Praktisk erfarenhet i rollen som Data Scientist eller liknande position.
* Gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av maskininlärning och dess livscykel samt djupare kunskap inom AI, gärna med fokus på Computer Vision, NLP eller närliggande område.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och tillhörande ramverk och bibliotek.
* God förståelse för och allmän erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling (frontend, backend, DevOps).


 Meriterande är även om du har:
   

  

* Praktisk erfarenhet av statistisk analys, klassificering och prediktiv modellering.
* Erfarenhet från skadehantering inom försäkringsbranschen.


 Som person är du självgående och trivs med att arbeta i mindre team där stort ansvar och drivkraft för att leda egna projekt framåt är avgörande. Nyfikenhet och analytisk förmåga är viktiga egenskaper, och du finner glädje i att lösa svåra problem. Förmågan att snabbt sätta dig in i nya teknologier och metoder gör att du ständigt utvecklas och bidrar till teamets framgång.
   

  

 Du har stark kommunikativ förmåga, särskilt när det gäller att förklara komplexa tekniska koncept på ett lättförståeligt sätt för både kollegor och kunder. Att ligga i framkant inom ditt område och att dela med dig av insikter och kunskaper till resten av teamet är något som driver dig.
   

  

**Kontaktpersoner**
 Rekryterande chef: poja.daroui@agria.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: mirek.Swartz@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: ellinor.jateus@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
 Agria är ett helägt dotterbolag till Länsförsäkringar och finns idag i Sverige, Norge, Finland, Danmark, Storbritannien, Tyskland, Frankrike och Irland. Vårt svenska kontor ligger på Gärdet i Stockholm, men vårt hjärta och verksamhet sträcker sig långt utanför Sveriges gränser. Med en tydlig tillväxt agenda fortsätter vi att expandera internationellt, driva innovation och utveckla digitala lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för djurägare. Ett exempel är vårt dotterbolag Agria Vet Guide, som erbjuder digital rådgivning och gör det enklare att hjälpa fler djur snabbare.
   

  

 Vi är marknadsledande i Norden inom djur- och husdjursförsäkringar, med en tydlig vision: att bli Europas mest omtyckta och pålitliga partner för djurägare. Vårt ledarskap handlar inte bara om marknadsandelar; det handlar om att skapa trygghet för både djur och människor, och att göra livet med djur enklare och roligare.

title: Röntgensjuksköterska med uppdrag som objektspecialist/systemstöd inom RIS/PACS
description:

****Du erbjuds****



* en kombinationstjänst där du får möjlighet att förena kliniskt arbete med ett verksamhetsnära uppdrag inom RIS/PACS
* möjlighet att bidra till utveckling och förbättring av arbetssätt och systemstöd inom mammografiverksamheten

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

* erfarenhet av att planera och genomföra utbildningar samt ta fram användarstöd och dokumentation.

* erfarenhet av ärendehantering och incidenthantering

 As our
 **AI Enablement Engineer**

title: Tech Lead
description:

 **Tech Lead**

title: Product Experience Specialist
description:
**TL;DR**
 We're looking for Product Experience Specialists to deliver world-class support and shape the future of Lovable. You will be on the front lines of a fast-growing product, solving real user problems and feeding insights directly into product development. You will also take ownership of how we build, document, and improve support at scale. This role is for someone who has recently completed a bachelor's or master's degree, is user- and product-obsessed, cares deeply about helping others succeed, and is ready to grow into real responsibility fast.
   

  

 This is a full-time, remote contractor position requiring availability during APAC business hours to provide seamless support coverage for our global user base.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* A driver, not a passenger: You spot problems before they're pointed out, come up with improvements on your own initiative, and follow through.
* Analytical problem solver: You break down complex situations systematically and move fast to get users unblocked even if it is something we haven’t seen before. You see opportunities where others see obstacles.
* Curious: You test ideas, try new approaches, and aren't afraid to get it wrong the first time. You're naturally drawn to AI tools and see the potential to get things done faster and smarter.
* Crystal-clear communicator: Whether it's a user reply, a bug report, or an internal process doc, you communicate warmly and precisely.
* 3 years experience in B2C SaaS support using tools like Intercom.
* Bonus: Hands-on experience with Lovable, Claude and similar AI tools.


**What You'll Do**
* Own user problems end to end: Become a Lovable expert to solve a wide range of issues with speed and clarity, and escalate effectively to engineering when needed.
* Improve our support stack: Keep our internal knowledge base up to date, design smarter workflows, and find ways to make the whole team operate better.
* Be the voice of the customer: Continuously feed product feedback into the team so that what you see on the front lines actually improves the product.
* Grow your scope: As you build trust and ownership, the role expands. Internally at Lovable and externally in how we engage with users and the community, there is real room to develop.


**About Your Application**
 We welcome candidates from all backgrounds. What matters to us is mindset, drive, and curiosity. Please apply through our application system in English as it is our company language.

* Comfortable influencing stakeholders and driving change without relying on formal authority

 You enjoy combining hands-on work with driving improvements and enabling others to succeed.

 ,

title: Calibration Engineer
description:
We are looking to expand our EATS´ team with a Calibration Engineer to work within Engine Controls & Diagnostics.
  
  

**Job description:**  

You will work in a team responsible for securing that the engine fulfils the emission legislation, by developing and calibrating its own inhouse software models. The team consists of calibration engineers and function developers. You & the team will calibrate start and catalyst heating, emission control and purge control. The team delivers engine software to combustion engines in both mild hybrid and hybrid applications.
  
From an early stage you will be involved in the development of new powertrain concepts and its software, where the team has the responsibility for vehicle emissions, and develop solutions that meet both legal requirements and give the customer an outstanding product.
  
Early in the projects you will be collecting data from the engine test rigs, in order to calibrate the software-models. Validation and later, final verification are always performed in cars or what the application is suited for. The job variety is huge and the need for further development is always there, which provides an interesting research atmosphere.
  
  

**What you will do:**  

You will work in a team with experienced engineers but have a clear area of responsibility. Your main tasks will be to calibrate emission-related functions.
  
The team is doing a large amount of our work in different engine test cells located in the laboratory, but also in vehicles on site and during expeditions to find extreme climates and altitudes. You will use advanced programs for modelling and data processing for best results.
  
  

**﻿Main tasks:**  

Plan and develop methods of the calibration process.
  
Define and handle requirements within the system and from other areas.
  
Deliver calibration and verification of emission related functions.
  
Verify calibration in rigs and cars in different environments.
  
Evaluation and problem analysis.
  
  

Is this you?
  
To enjoy and succeed in the role, we see that you have a great interest in the latest technology, and you have an interest in powertrain controls and calibration. You also like to dig into a huge amount of data. You are a positive and self-driven person, who strives to see "the big picture" to be able to contribute in the best way. You appreciate being a part of a team and are a good communicator. Further, you are always curious, and love to solve problems in a pragmatic way!
  
Skill requirements
  
  

**Qualifications:**  

* We believe you have a Bachelor’s or Master’s in the field of Mechanical, Physics, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent You have a passion for cars and internal combustion engines.
* Fluent in Matlab/Python/Simulink
* Fluent in English (written and spoken)
* Driver’s license (Swedish B-level, passenger car)
* Fluent in Swedish (written and spoken) is a plus
* Good knowledge of internal combustion engines
* Passion for vehicles and powertrains
* Theoretical courses in combustion engines, software programming and electronics
* Experience in ETAS INCA software


﻿Personal qualities
  
* Self-driven with a positive attitude
* Strong analytical skills as well as being able to execute tests “hands-on”
* You plan, conduct, summarize and report your work in a structured and thorough manner
* A curious and problemsolving mindset
* You can easily communicate and collaborate
* A true teamplayer open and supportive


This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to advanced engine development while being part of a collaborative and supportive team.
  
You need to be living in Sweden and be able to work 100% onsite in Gothenburg.
  
Looking forward to meeting you!

title: Dataarkitekt
description:

Vi söker dig som är en erfaren och driven dataarkitekt som kan arbeta både strategiskt och operativt med fokus på datalager och integration. Var med och bidra till skolans framtid!
